changelog: Sales team view: `/sales/board`, `/sales` and `/sales/accounts` get a "Mine / Team" toggle (`?view=team`); every rep reads every record and account of their org, and a colleague's lead page opens read-only with an owner banner. Writing stays owner / dispatcher / admin (`salesBookReadWhere` + `salesBookWriteAllowed` in `src/lib/salesBookRule.ts`); the board disables drag and the stage picker on cards you cannot write, and every write route keeps its own ownership check.

en: Team view: see every record of your team, read-only — switch between Mine and Team on the board, the dashboard and the accounts.
tr: Ekip görünümü: tüm ekip kayıtları salt-okunur görülebilir — panoda, ana sayfada ve hesaplarda Benim / Ekip arasında geçiş yapın.
de: Teamansicht: alle Datensätze des Teams schreibgeschützt einsehen — auf dem Board, der Startseite und bei den Accounts zwischen Meine und Team wechseln.
